cues.zh: 这不是一个反对吃肉的视频。
cues.en: This is not an anti meat video.

cues.zh: 我们都听过反对吃肉的理由，
cues.en: We’ve all heard the arguments against meat,

cues.zh: 然而，在欧盟和美国，
cues.en: and yet, in the EU and US

cues.zh: 只有1%到6%的人不吃肉。
cues.en: only between 1% and 6% of people don’t eat it.

cues.zh: 肉实在太好吃了，太方便了，而且深深植根于我们的文化，
cues.en: Meat is just too tasty, convenient and ingrained in our culture

cues.zh: 以至于我们大多数人根本不会考虑放弃吃肉。
cues.en: for most of us to consider giving it up.

cues.zh: 而且，饮食是个人选择，没人喜欢被道德说教。
cues.en: Also, food is personal and nobody likes to be morally lectured.

cues.zh: 与此同时，我们热爱动物。
cues.en: At the same time, we love animals.

cues.zh: 我们大多数人养宠物，也相信动物权利。
cues.en: Most of us have pets and believe in animal rights.

cues.zh: 很少有事情能像虐待动物那样让互联网如此愤怒。
cues.en: Few things make the internet as angry as animal cruelty.

cues.zh: 这两件事都是真的。
cues.en: Both are true.

cues.zh: 我们爱肉，我们也爱动物。
cues.en: We love meat and we love animals.

cues.zh: 不幸的是，我们吃的大多数动物生活在极其恶劣的条件下。
cues.en: Unfortunately, most animals we eat live in truly horrible conditions.

cues.zh: 我们折磨它们不是为了取乐，
cues.en: We don't torture them for fun,

cues.zh: 而是因为这能让肉便宜那么一点点。
cues.en: but because it makes meat just a little bit more incredibly cheap.

cues.zh: 如果我们每个人都多付一点点，就能避免大部分动物的痛苦。
cues.en: If we all paid just a tad more, we could avoid most animal suffering.

cues.zh: 通常每餐只要几分钱。
cues.en: Often just for a few pennies per meal.

cues.zh: 免责声明：农业很复杂。
cues.en: Disclaimer: farming is complicated.

cues.zh: 许多农民真心想尽可能给动物最好的生活，
cues.en: Many farmers are genuinely trying to give their animals the best life possible,

cues.zh: 但他们被困在一个复杂的系统里，
cues.en: but they are trapped in a complex system

cues.zh: 承受着巨大的市场压力，要压低价格。
cues.en: with extreme market pressure to keep prices low.

cues.zh: 没有两个国家的标准是一样的，
cues.en: No two countries have the same standards,

cues.zh: 没有两个农场是相同的，
cues.en: no two farms are equal,

cues.zh: 可靠的数据往往很稀缺。
cues.en: and solid data is often scarce.

cues.en: We’ve done our best to combine data from different regions

cues.zh: 以及你最终支付的价格。
cues.en: and the prices you pay in the end.

cues.zh: 为简单起见，我们将养殖方式分类
cues.en: To keep things simple, we're going to classify farming practices

cues.zh: 为三大类。
cues.en: into three broad groups.

cues.zh: 体面的、监狱和酷刑营。
cues.en: Decent, prisons and torture camps.

cues.zh: 这有点粗略，
cues.en: This is a bit sketchy,

cues.zh: 你可能在超市里见过更多分类，
cues.en: and you've probably seen many more categories in the supermarket,

cues.zh: 比如"有机"或"草饲"。
cues.en: like "organic" or "grass-fed".

cues.zh: 这些我们稍后再谈。
cues.en: We'll come to that later.

cues.zh: 那么，各位杂食者，
cues.en: So, fellow omnivores,

cues.zh: 要避免动物遭受酷刑
cues.en: what would it cost us to avoid animal torture

cues.zh: 还能吃上炸鸡，我们需要付出多少代价？
cues.en: and still have our fried chicken?

cues.zh: 任何时候，
cues.en: At any given time,

cues.zh: 地球上大约有260亿只活鸡——
cues.en: there are about 26 billion chickens alive on Earth -

cues.zh: 和其他所有鸟类的总和一样多。
cues.en: as many as all other birds combined.

cues.zh: 鸡看起来笨笨的，但它们是社会性动物，
cues.en: Chickens seem dumb, but they are social,

cues.zh: 能交流、解决问题，还能共情。
cues.en: can communicate, solve problems and feel empathy.

cues.zh: 然而，我们却把绝大多数鸡置于疯狂的折磨之中。
cues.en: And yet, we keep the vast majority in insane torture.

cues.zh: 先从鸡蛋说起。
cues.en: Let’s start with eggs.

cues.zh: 全世界约90%的蛋鸡生活在折磨营里——
cues.en: Worldwide, about 90% of laying hens live in torture camps -

cues.zh: 挤在极其狭小的笼子里，几乎动弹不得。
cues.en: crammed in extremely tight cages where they can barely move.

cues.zh: 它们无法展现任何鸡的自然行为，
cues.en: They are unable to show any natural chicken behavior

cues.zh: 比如筑巢、栖枝、觅食或啄地，
cues.en: like nesting, roosting, foraging or pecking at the ground,

cues.zh: 于是变得极度沮丧，
cues.en: so they become extremely frustrated

cues.zh: 最终严重互相伤害。
cues.en: and end up hurting each other badly.

cues.zh: 为了阻止这种情况，许多养殖场会给它们断喙。
cues.en: To stop this, many farms clip their beaks.

cues.zh: 在美国和欧洲，
cues.en: In the US and Europe,

cues.zh: 法律禁令和消费者倡议已大大改善了状况，
cues.en: legal bans and consumer initiatives have improved the situation a lot

cues.zh: 就在过去几年里。
cues.en: in the last few years.

cues.zh: 但仍有超过50%的母鸡被关在笼子里。
cues.en: But still, more than 50% of hens remain in cages.

cues.zh: 离谱的是，这样做甚至省不了多少钱。
cues.en: The insane thing is that this doesn’t even save a lot of money.

cues.zh: 假设一打鸡蛋大约要3.6欧元或美元——
cues.en: Let’s say a dozen eggs costs you around 3.60 euros or dollars -

cues.zh: 每个鸡蛋30美分。
cues.en: 30 cents per egg.

cues.zh: 解放这些母鸡要花多少钱？
cues.en: How much does it cost to free the hens?

cues.zh: 笼子的主要替代方案是“谷仓系统”。
cues.en: The main alternative to cages are “barn systems”.

cues.zh: 母鸡仍然养在室内，但空间翻倍，可以自由活动。
cues.en: Hens are still kept indoors but have twice as much space and roam freely.

cues.zh: 谷仓也是监狱：虽然不算理想，但已经好太多了。
cues.en: Barns are prisons: still not amazing but so much better.

cues.zh: 在欧盟，谷仓系统让消费者价格大约上涨……
cues.en: In the EU, barns increase the consumer price by about…

cues.zh: 每个鸡蛋2美分。
cues.en: 2 cents per egg.

cues.zh: 还算过得去的替代方案是“散养”，
cues.en: The somewhat decent alternative is “free range”,

cues.zh: 母鸡可以到户外，通常能真正接触到植被。
cues.en: where hens are allowed outdoors, often with proper access to vegetation.

cues.zh: 在欧盟，这会让价格大约上涨每个鸡蛋7美分。
cues.en: In the EU, this increases the price by about 7 cents per egg.

cues.zh: 除了居住条件，最残忍的做法之一是扑杀雏鸡。
cues.en: Housing aside, one of the cruelest practices is chick culling.

cues.zh: 雄性小鸡不会下蛋，所以一出生就会被杀掉，
cues.en: Male chicks don’t lay eggs so they are killed right after birth,

cues.zh: 通常是用毒气或绞碎的方式。
cues.en: usually by gassing or grinding.

cues.zh: 这是笼养鸡中非常普遍的做法，
cues.en: This is a really widespread practice used for caged,

cues.zh: 谷仓养殖甚至有机鸡蛋也是如此。
cues.en: barn and even organic eggs.

cues.zh: 每年有70亿只小鸡以这种方式被杀死。
cues.en: 7 billion baby chickens are killed this way each year.

cues.zh: 法国和德国已经禁止了这种做法，
cues.en: France and Germany have banned this

cues.zh: 所以这里很多种蛋会提前扫描，
cues.en: so many breeding eggs here are scanned early

cues.zh: 只孵化雌性小鸡。
cues.en: and only female birds hatch.

cues.zh: 这可能只让每枚鸡蛋的成本增加了2到5美分。
cues.en: Which may have increased costs by only 2 to 5 cents per egg.

cues.zh: 所以如果你买一打鸡蛋多付85美分，
cues.en: So if you pay 85 cents more for a dozen eggs,

cues.zh: 你就能在严重的鸡只虐待
cues.en: you can make a difference between serious chicken torture

cues.zh: 和相当不错的鸡的生活之间做出改变。
cues.en: and pretty decent chicken lives.

cues.zh: 再花60美分，你还能帮助终结小鸡扑杀。
cues.en: And for another 60 cents, you can help end chick culling too.

cues.zh: 鸡肉则是另一回事。
cues.en: Chicken meat is a different story.

cues.zh: 如今大多数肉鸡都是基因怪物，
cues.en: Most meat chickens today are genetic freaks,

cues.zh: 被培育成能以惊人速度长到惊人的体重。
cues.en: bred to reach amazing weights incredibly fast.

cues.zh: 它们的内部器官承受着巨大的压力
cues.en: Their internal organs are under a huge amount of stress

cues.zh: 因为体重，它们甚至无法正常行走，
cues.en: and they can’t even walk properly because of their weight,

cues.zh: 这给它们一生中的大部分时间带来很多痛苦。
cues.en: which causes them a lot of pain for much of their lives.

cues.zh: 这里很难给出确切数字，
cues.en: It is hard to give exact numbers here,

cues.zh: 但如果农民改养生长更慢、痛苦少得多的品种，
cues.en: but if farmers were to switch to breeds that grow slower and suffer far less,

cues.zh: 你在美国花1.5美元买的一份鸡胸肉
cues.en: a serving of chicken breast that you buy at 1.5 dollars

cues.zh: 会贵9美分。
cues.en: would become 9 cents more expensive in the US.

cues.zh: 欧盟90%的肉鸡生活在监狱或酷刑营里。
cues.en: 90% of meat chickens in the EU live in prisons or torture camps.

cues.zh: 它们被关在室内，条件极其拥挤，
cues.en: They are kept indoors in extremely crowded conditions,

cues.zh: 有时每平方米有几十只鸡，
cues.en: with sometimes dozens of birds per square meter,

cues.zh: 常常处于黑暗中，通风很差。
cues.en: often in the dark and with poor ventilation.

cues.zh: 那如果我们把它们全都搬进监狱呢？
cues.en: So what if we moved them all to prisons?

cues.zh: 一项欧盟研究发现，给它们多30%的空间、
cues.en: One EU study found that giving them 30% more space,

cues.zh: 栖木、新鲜空气和日光
cues.en: perches, fresh air and daylight

cues.zh: 会让每份价格再增加13美分。
cues.en: would increase the price by another 13 cents per serving.

cues.zh: 可能不到5%的肉鸡是散养的
cues.en: Probably less than 5% of meat chickens live free range

cues.zh: 生活条件还算过得去。
cues.en: in relatively decent conditions.

cues.zh: 这种肉明显更贵，
cues.en: This meat is actually noticeably more expensive,

cues.zh: 是“普通”鸡肉价格的两倍。
cues.en: double the price of “regular” chicken.

cues.zh: 但鸡肉是最便宜的肉。
cues.en: But chicken is the cheapest meat.

cues.zh: 所以取决于部位，
cues.en: So depending on the cut,

cues.zh: 你要多付35美分到1欧元或1美元
cues.en: you'd pay 35 cents to 1 euro or dollar more

cues.zh: 才能吃到一只过得还不错的鸡。
cues.en: for a serving of chicken that had a decent life.

cues.zh: 猪基本上就是狗。
cues.en: Pigs are basically dogs.

cues.zh: 它们和我们的狼朋友一样聪明、合群、爱玩
cues.en: They are as intelligent, social and playful as our wolf buddies

cues.zh: 还能当可爱的宠物——
cues.en: and make lovable pets -

cues.zh: 所以猪真的能感受到自己的生活状态
cues.en: so pigs really feel how they live

cues.zh: 可以说它们是我们所吃动物中境遇最惨的。
cues.en: and arguably have it the worst of all animals we eat.

cues.zh: 可能超过90%的猪生活在折磨营里。
cues.en: Probably more than 90% of all pigs live in torture camps.

cues.zh: 它们一辈子都待在室内极其拥挤的空间里，
cues.en: They spend their entire lives indoors in extremely crowded spaces,

cues.zh: 踩在混凝土地面上，没有稻草或垫料。
cues.en: on concrete floors without straw or bedding.

cues.zh: 因为这远远达不到它们的需求，
cues.en: Since this is far from what they need,

cues.zh: 它们会变得沮丧，经常打架。
cues.en: they get frustrated and often fight.

cues.zh: 小猪的尾巴会被剪短，防止咬尾。
cues.en: Piglets have their tails docked to stop tail-biting.

cues.zh: 大多数公猪出生后会被阉割，让肉更好吃，
cues.en: Most males are castrated after birth so that their meat will taste better,

cues.zh: 常常为了省时间不打止痛。
cues.en: often without pain relief to save time.

cues.zh: 母猪被关在“限位栏”里——
cues.en: Mothers are kept in “crates” -

cues.zh: 极其狭窄的金属束缚架，完全无法动弹。
cues.en: extremely tight metal straight jackets, where they can’t move at all.

cues.zh: 这给母猪和仔猪带来极大痛苦，
cues.en: This leads to extreme suffering for the mother and for the piglets,

cues.zh: 仔猪被关在光秃秃的区域，用金属栅栏隔开，
cues.en: which are held in a barren area, separated by metal bars

cues.zh: 才三周大就被带走。
cues.en: and taken away at just three weeks old.

cues.zh: 想象一下这样对待狗。
cues.en: Imagine treating dogs like that.

cues.zh: 首先，我们来看看监狱级别。
cues.en: First, let’s get to the prison level.

cues.zh: 取消限位栏会让一份2欧元的猪肉
cues.en: Getting rid of crates would raise the cost of a €2 serving of pork

cues.zh: 涨价约20欧分。
cues.en: by about 20 cents.

cues.zh: 阉割麻醉几乎不花钱，
cues.en: Anesthesia for castration costs almost nothing,

cues.zh: 每公斤肉大约1欧分。
cues.en: around 1 cent per kilogram of meat.

cues.zh: 丹麦一项研究发现，给猪
cues.en: And a study in Denmark found that giving pigs

cues.zh: 更多稻草和垫料，
cues.en: more straw and bedding material

cues.zh: 多30%的空间以及其他更善待动物的措施，
cues.en: and 30% more space and other things that are more animal-friendly

cues.zh: 会让每份肉再涨价20欧分。
cues.en: would increase the price per serving by another 20 cents.

cues.zh: 对这么聪明的动物来说，这样的生活还是很糟糕，
cues.en: This is still an awful life for an animal this intelligent,

cues.zh: 但显然好多了。
cues.en: but obviously much better.

cues.zh: 每份只需多花40美分。
cues.en: For 40 cents more per serving.

cues.zh: 再进一步，让猪在生命中至少40%的时间里
cues.en: Going one level further and giving pigs outdoor access

cues.zh: 能到户外活动，
cues.en: for at least 40% of their lives

cues.zh: 室内空间增加300%到400%，
cues.en: and 300-400% more space indoors

cues.zh: 每份价格会再涨80美分。
cues.en: would increase the price per serving by another 80 cents.

cues.zh: 欧盟只有略高于1%的猪生活在这样的或类似条件下。
cues.en: Just over 1% of pigs in the EU live in these or similar conditions.

cues.zh: 我们无法确定这对如此聪明又合群的动物来说是否真的可以接受，
cues.en: We can't know if this is really okay for such a smart and social animal

cues.zh: 但这至少开始像点样子了。
cues.en: but it starts resembling something decent.

cues.zh: 而这一切，每份猪肉只需多花约1.2美元或欧元。
cues.en: And all for about 1.2 dollars or euros more per serving of pig.

cues.zh: 肉用牛的待遇最好，
cues.en: Cows raised for meat have it the best

cues.zh: 因为它们通常有约三分之二的生命在户外度过，
cues.en: because they usually spend about two thirds of their lives outdoors,

cues.zh: 生活相当不错。
cues.en: making their lives pretty good.

cues.zh: 如果它们在野外，基本也是一样的生活，只是没那么安全。
cues.en: If they were in the wild, it would be basically the same thing but less safe.

cues.zh: 但它们的生活远非完美。
cues.en: Their lives are far from perfect, though.

cues.zh: 尤其是结局。
cues.en: Especially the end.

cues.zh: 绝大多数奶牛在短暂生命的最后几个月
cues.en: The vast majority of cows spend the last months of their short lives

cues.zh: 是在“育肥场”度过的——
cues.en: in “finishing feedlots” -

cues.zh: 那要么是监狱，要么是酷刑营，
cues.en: either prisons or torture camps

cues.zh: 在那里它们被催肥，以尽快达到屠宰体重。
cues.en: where they are fattened to reach their slaughter weight as fast as possible.

cues.zh: 美国大概不到5%的肉牛
cues.en: Probably less than 5% of beef cattle in the US

cues.zh: 能终身在户外牧场活动。
cues.en: have lifelong access to outdoor pasture.

cues.zh: 然而，德国最近一项研究发现，
cues.en: And yet, a recent German study found

cues.zh: 这只会让牛肉价格上涨约15%。
cues.en: that it only increases the price of beef by around 15%.

cues.zh: 即便在同一国家或地区内，奶牛的生活质量也差异巨大，
cues.en: The life quality of cows varies widely even within countries and regions,

cues.en: depending on the available land, climate and farming traditions.

cues.zh: 所以真的很难再提出更简单、更廉价的建议
cues.en: So it's really impossible to make more easy and cheap suggestions

cues.zh: 来改善它们的生活。
cues.en: to make their lives better.

cues.en: Dairy cows do have it much worse.

cues.zh: 它们一年中大部分时间常被关在室内，
cues.en: They are often kept indoors for most of the year

cues.zh: 因站在混凝土上而饱受疼痛、蹄底溃疡和损伤之苦。

cues.en: But once again, none of these things seem to be needed to have affordable milk.

cues.en: by about 10 cents per liter.

cues.en: but the summary is clear.

cues.en: from outright torture to somewhat decent

cues.en: and 100% for chicken meat.

cues.zh: 以至于我们必须折磨动物才能把价格压到极低。

cues.en: This really is all there is to it.

cues.en: Food in developed countries is the cheapest it's been in history.

cues.en: In the US, the largest meat consumer in the world,
